description: Median monthly rent paid by renter households, including utilities the renter pays (gross rent).

source.dataset: American Community Survey 5-year estimates, Table B25064 (2020–2024)

howToRead: Gross rent includes utilities and fuels the renter pays, so it is higher than contract rent alone.
Each year is a 5-year average: "2024" covers 2020–2024. Compare periods that don't overlap for the clearest trend.
title: Median rent by county
caveats: Covers all renters, including long-time tenants on older leases, so it runs below current asking rents.
Survey estimates: small counties have wide margins of error, so modest differences there are often noise.
Connecticut replaced its counties with planning regions in 2022, so it appears as no data on the county map.
